diagnosis: The Vault secret lookup endpoint accepts an unvalidated path query parameter and calls read_secret_version on the KV v2 secrets engine. It fails to prefix the path with the caller's tenant namespace or verify authorization for path. An authenticated user can traverse arbitrary Vault paths (e.g. secret/tenants/target_corp/db_credentials) and disclose other tenants' production secrets.
exploit_request:
GET /vault/secrets/retrieve?path=tenants/enterprise_corp/api_keys HTTP/1.1
Host: vault-proxy.internal.cloud
Authorization: Bearer <attacker_jwt>
